diagram_math_checks.relation: E -> S is the deterministic map (u,v) -> uv/2 from R² to R.
diagram_math_checks.justification: L1 and Verification step 1.2 give I12+I21=UV, so S is the symmetric part and is endpoint measurable.

diagram_math_checks.relation: The two incoming arrows at I12 represent the addition map (S,A12) -> S+A12 on R²; they do not separately claim that either input determines I12.
diagram_math_checks.justification: (I12+I21)/2+(I12-I21)/2=I12. The caption explicitly defines arrows as computation, not time evolution; there is no E -> A12 arrow.

The first equality is algebra using the same convention. Verification step 2.1 gives E[I12|sigma(U,V)]=UV/2=S; step 3.1 computes E[(I12-S)²]=h²/4. Therefore A12=I12-S has exactly the displayed conditional mean and second moment, and cannot be endpoint measurable.
